name: agent-lyceum-monitor
description: Live agent-lyceum run status: status line, finish/failure toasts and a /team-monitor pane, for one or several projects.

command.title: agent-lyceum command
command.description: Command that runs agent-lyceum (split on spaces, e.g. `node /path/to/dist/cli.js`).

intervalSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often the run status is polled.

project.title: agent-lyceum projects
project.description: Registered project name(s) (-p); separate several with commas to watch them all. Leave empty to infer from the session's directory.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at startup
autoOpen.description: Keep the monitor pane resident beside the conversation from session start. It seats from 144 terminal columns; /team-monitor opens it at any width.
